candidates.source_description: When Lu Asey Keanna Oyao’s family couldn’t afford to rent a ball gown for her junior-senior prom, her brother Maverick Francisco Oyao decided to make one for her himself. A Culture and Arts Education student in Zamboanga City, Maverick had never made a dress before, so he turned to YouTube and Google for guidance and found inspiration in Filipino designer Michael Cinco. candidates.source_title: Nearly 1 Million Animals Died for His Art #art #history
candidates.source_description:
Almost a million animals have died for Damien Hirst’s art. One estimate puts the total at over 913,000 creatures, including farm animals, sea creatures, and roughly 912,000 insects.

But one of Hirst’s most notorious artworks features a tiger shark caught for £6,000 and suspended in formaldehyde. The artwork reportedly sold for $8 million. Years later, the shark began to rot — so Hirst replaced it.

Would you consider this art?
